admissions.threshold: Biology (St. George, Arts & Science, OUAC TLG): complete IB Diploma including English, with Biology, Chemistry (HL/SL) and Maths for calculus (AI HL, or AA SL/HL). Admission is competitive.

Biology (St. George, Arts & Science, OUAC TLG): five different IGCSE/GCSE/O-Level subjects and three different A-Levels, including English (IGCSE or higher), Biology, Chemistry and Maths (AS/A-Level). Admission is competitive.
Biology (St. George, Arts & Science, OUAC TLG): a high school diploma from an accredited school, with senior-level (or AP/IB) English, Biology, Calculus and Chemistry. Admission is competitive.
